mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as risk aversion rises.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and residential sales indicate broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth > 2.5% and unemployment < 4.0%), a monthly decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when HOUST declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales falling below $500 billion in a month indicates housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as consumer confidence weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 500000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate and declines in payroll employment signal labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), a year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals aggressive policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production indicates manufacturing sector weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 1-year rolling windows.
